description: This file defines a class 'Cron' in the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Marketplace' namespace. It manages marketplace-related cron jobs within the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, running, enabling, disabling, and deleting scheduled cron tasks. The class extends the core controller class and provides methods for handling CRUD operations of cron jobs, generating URLs with filtering options, and rendering views for the cron list and details.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Controller class handling CRUD and execution of marketplace cron jobs in the OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the marketplace cron page, with filters and breadcrumbs, and prepare data for the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of cron tasks, including sorting, pagination, and filtering.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list data of cron jobs based on current filters and sorting.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a specific cron job based on cron_id parameter, calling the respective controller action.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables a specified cron job by setting its status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables a specified cron job, setting its status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified cron job from the system.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected cron jobs based on POST data, with permission checks, and sends a JSON response indicating success or error.
